title: Fair Lending in Car Financing: Unintended Racial Consequences of Consumer Financial Protection Bureau Supervision of Dealer Markups
eligible_reason: Single intervention date (CFPB supervisory highlights, 2014). Main design is regression discontinuity in time with a 30-day window, a polynomial in time and time-varying controls. The DiD-style year-on-year check in Web Appendix L is two-period with one date. Lender-level adoption of flat compensation is used only descriptively and as an outcome (Table 4, Table W18), not as a staggered DiD.
design_notes: Table 3 and 4 use bootstrapped SEs, RDiT with order-1 polynomial in time, multiple fixed effects and controls, 378,758 loan observations. Interactions with credit-union dummy and minority-tercile dummy are subgroup-by-treatment interactions. Lender flat-compensation switches (675 credit unions, 18 banks) are inferred from zero-markup spells.
screener_notes: Text-only screen. No package_dir. Transaction-level auto loan data from a prominent market research firm (proprietary); credit-score data anonymized. Not eligible: single adoption date, RDiT, controls.
